milestones.title: Keycloak runs in strict FIPS mode on the rig

remediation: Keycloak's FIPS mode was deferred when the stack was built. Turn on strict FIPS mode with a BC-FIPS version that a certificate names (G332), on a FIPS host, and test sign-in with passkeys and smart cards in that mode.
title: Keycloak does not run in FIPS mode yet
